Bienvenidos! Just one week after 4,365 Duelists competed at the 100th YCS in Long Beach, CA, the Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series tournament makes its way to the beautiful city of Lima for what is sure to be another exciting event.
Stay tuned for continuing coverage of the first ever YCS in Peru!

Felipe Pucha (Ecuador)

One of the best parts of attending a YCS tournament is the variety of different tournaments you can play in. There are different types of events for Duelists of all ages and level of experience. One of the tournaments most players enjoy best is the Win-A-Mat tournaments.
In Win-A-Mat tournaments, Duelists bring a constructed Deck and play against opponents in a Single-Elimination tournament. The winner of the event wins an official Win-A-Mat Game Mat.
Congratulations to Santiago Acevedo (Peru) for winning the first Win-A-Mat tournament of the weekend!
Santiago Acevedo (Peru)
